_about: Fed emergency actions 2000-01-01..2026-10-31 under SPEC v1 §3 marker 5 (Dollar watch forward onset rule). One row per press release; several rows may share a date. Each URL fetched on 2026-11-02 (HTTP 200) and its title and announcement date checked against the page; sha256_prefix is of the fetched bytes (federalreserve.gov pages carry dynamic chrome, so the hash identifies the fetch, not the text).

included: FOMC cut of the federal funds target announced outside a scheduled FOMC meeting (intermeeting cut)
a new lending facility or loan authorised under Section 13(3) of the Federal Reserve Act, or another new temporary emergency lending facility or authority (e.g. TAF, the 2008 GSE lending authority)
a new or expanded central-bank liquidity swap line: new counterparty, larger limit, lower price, longer operation tenor, or higher operation frequency
excluded: changes to the discount (primary credit) rate alone, e.g. 2007-08-17
open market and repo operations, e.g. the Sept-2019 NY Fed repo operations
expansions, collateral changes, extensions or wind-downs of an existing lending facility (e.g. 2008-09-14, 2008-12-02)
conversions to standing status without new terms (swap lines 2013-10-31; FIMA repo and the Standing Repo Facility 2021-07-28)
asset purchase programmes and rate cuts at scheduled meetings
rulings: Reverse (foreign-currency) liquidity swap lines count as a new central-bank liquidity swap line: the clause does not distinguish direction (ruled 2026-11-03, before any forward evaluation; it decides only 2009-04-06, which lies inside the 2009-01 exclusion).
One-firm 13(3) arrangements (AIG, Citigroup, Bank of America) count as a new loan under Section 13(3).

source_feed: https://www.federalreserve.gov/json/ne-press.json (2006-01..2026-10 searched for facility/swap/13(3)/FIMA/intermeeting releases; none after 2023-03-19); 2000-2005 from the boarddocs archive

update_rule: Append-only, kept date-sorted; every row carries its fetched URL, title and date check. At each R1 the list is reviewed through the previous month (reviewed_through) BEFORE that month's onset evaluation; every forward addition or exclusion is checked by a second reader (a counter-agent) and logged with added_on. A row is never removed; a correction is a new row plus a note.
onset_check_note: The 2026-11-02 pre-committed onset check ran on the list with sha256 onset_check_list_sha256 (48 rows); the two rows added on 2026-11-03 do not change its count (8 onsets, 31 months with 2+ markers).
